reasoning_content: All documented password hashes are verified. Next, I'll perform an actual login test via the running development server (devise authentication with CSRF token).

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "token: ${TOKEN:0:20}..." && curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "POST login: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" && curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "GET /admin: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin && curl -s -b cj.txt http://localhost:3000/admin | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1
